title: Cobblemon BUSSIN Edition
description: That unique 4 week experience, utilising Create & Oritech, with oritech ores moved to custom mining dimension, Advanced megastone craft and more.
body:
# 🪨⚙️ Bussin Cobblemon

A curated Cobblemon survival experience with Create-powered progression, custom systems, and controlled complexity.

## ✨ What is Bussin Cobblemon?

_Bussin Cobblemon is a carefully designed modpack that blends the cozy, nostalgic feel of Pokémon-style adventure with Minecraft survival and Create-driven progression — without turning into a tech-overload pack._

**This pack is built for:**
- Players who want meaningful progression
- Servers with short–mid lifespans (≈3–4 weeks)
- Older Pokémon fans who value simplicity, discovery, and balance
- No endless ore bloat.
- No mandatory automation trees.
- Just intentional systems that feel good to play.

### 🟢 Cobblemon First

- Cobblemon is the heart of the experience
- Legendary acquisition is controlled and intentional
- No duplicate legendary spam across addons
- Capture rates, progression, and rewards are tuned for server longevity


### ⚙️ Create as the Main Complexity Mod

- Create is the only major tech backbone
- Custom alloys and metalworking progression
- Create integrates naturally into exploration, crafting, and automation
- No AE2-style systems or heavy tech chains


### ⛏️ The Mining Dimension

**To keep the Overworld clean and familiar:**
- Vanilla Minecraft ores stay in the Overworld
- All modded ores (Create, Oritech, etc.) are moved to a dedicated Mining Dimension
- The mining dimension is:
- Deep, flat, and resource-focused
- Free from mob and Cobblemon spawns
- Designed purely for mining and progression
- This keeps exploration meaningful and prevents ore clutter.


### 🔮 Bussin Overload (Custom Mod)

**This modpack includes a custom-built mod with:**
- New materials and crafting components
- Custom tools (including high-tier utility tools)
- Future expansion hooks for progression and content
- Designed specifically for this pack — not a generic addon.


### 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Multiplayer Focused

- Server-friendly performance
- Balanced progression for groups
- Designed to feel complete even on a fresh wipe


### ❤️ Credits & Inspiration

Inspired by:

- Cobblemon
- Create
- Vanilla-plus progression design
- Cozy SMP and short-season server formats
